scripts.db:reset:demo: echo '\n⚠️  ВНИМАНИЕ: База данных очищается!\n' && pnpm --filter @bidplace/database db:seed
scripts.test:unit: pnpm --filter @bidplace/config test && pnpm --filter @bidplace/api test && pnpm --filter @bidplace/contracts test && pnpm --filter @bidplace/api-client test && pnpm exec turbo run test --filter=@bidplace/database && pnpm --filter @bidplace/mobile test
scripts.verify: pnpm typecheck && pnpm lint && pnpm test:unit && pnpm test:ops && pnpm --filter @bidplace/mobile test:e2e-fence && pnpm test:integration && pnpm build
scripts.ops:verify-restore: pnpm exec turbo run build --filter=@bidplace/database && node scripts/ops/verify-restore-integrity.mjs
scripts.ops:backfill-media: pnpm exec turbo run build --filter=@bidplace/database && node scripts/ops/backfill-media-to-s3.mjs
scripts.ops:url-preflight: pnpm exec turbo run build --filter=@bidplace/database && node scripts/ops/url-preflight.mjs
scripts.ops:commerce-inventory: pnpm exec turbo run build --filter=@bidplace/database && node scripts/ops/commerce-inventory.mjs
scripts.cloudflare:check: pnpm exec tsc -p deploy/cloudflare/tsconfig.json && pnpm exec eslint deploy/cloudflare scripts/cloudflare --ext .ts,.mts,.mjs,.cjs && pnpm exec vitest run --config deploy/cloudflare/vitest.config.mts && node --test scripts/cloudflare/*.spec.mjs
